label: Frame-class strictness controls, checked (inference)
rule: Explicit frames checked by case analysis
meaning: Strictness of the four frame strength orders: on the reflexive non-transitive chain the route frame is KT and not S4; on the two-world order frame it is KT and not KTB, and S4 and not S5; on the reflexive symmetric non-transitive path it is KTB and not S5. So no weak frame premise entails its registered strong version. Model-witnessed only.
